d81e3e96b7fe14f5547f.en: An adverb tells us more about a verb: how, when or where something happens.
d81e3e96b7fe14f5547f.id: Kata keterangan (adverb) memberi tahu lebih banyak tentang kata kerja (verb): bagaimana, kapan, atau di mana sesuatu terjadi.

cfb849e96921742767ef.en: A preposition shows where or when, like under, through, after and during.
cfb849e96921742767ef.id: Kata depan (preposition) menunjukkan tempat atau waktu, seperti under, through, after, dan during.

fd36b94ad31d7fda0d3b.en: Use in for months, on for days and at for clock times.
fd36b94ad31d7fda0d3b.id: Pakai in untuk bulan, on untuk hari, dan at untuk jam.

7a630401c4e7988dd1c1.en: An adverbial can be one word or a phrase. When it moves to the front, it is a fronted adverbial.
7a630401c4e7988dd1c1.id: Adverbial bisa berupa satu kata atau sekelompok kata (phrase). Kalau pindah ke depan, namanya fronted adverbial.

eedb08f00608596bf110.en: Put a comma straight after a fronted adverbial.
eedb08f00608596bf110.id: Taruh koma (comma) tepat setelah fronted adverbial.

e5a57417c4fbba1a9aec.en: Tomorrow tells us when we will go swimming, so it is an adverb of time.
e5a57417c4fbba1a9aec.id: Tomorrow memberi tahu kapan kita akan berenang, jadi kata ini adalah kata keterangan waktu (adverb of time).

9d49832c8306946d607f.en: Swimming is the activity, not the time.

0e0a2fe80a62b6f9fea8.en: Go is part of the verb.
0e0a2fe80a62b6f9fea8.id: Go adalah bagian dari kata kerja (verb).

63647070acaad51c80c3.en: During the night is a fronted adverbial, so the comma goes straight after it.
63647070acaad51c80c3.id: During the night adalah keterangan di awal kalimat (fronted adverbial), jadi koma ditulis tepat setelahnya.

358c25361adf69d7b26e.en: During the night is one phrase. Do not split it.
358c25361adf69d7b26e.id: During the night adalah satu kelompok kata (phrase). Jangan dipisahkan.

b2fc5f630091d79d64eb.en: The comma goes after the fronted adverbial.
b2fc5f630091d79d64eb.id: Koma (comma) diletakkan setelah keterangan di awal kalimat (fronted adverbial).

369aba6eae454765aaed.en: Do not put a comma inside the phrase.
369aba6eae454765aaed.id: Jangan menaruh koma di dalam kelompok kata itu.

6bda354a1e2adc48f523.en: Slowly tells us how the tortoise walked, so it is an adverb.
6bda354a1e2adc48f523.id: Slowly memberi tahu bagaimana kura-kura itu berjalan, jadi kata ini adalah kata keterangan (adverb).

264aeef5d7278c286434.en: Tortoise is a noun. It names the animal.
264aeef5d7278c286434.id: Tortoise adalah kata benda (noun). Kata ini menyebut nama hewan itu.

a91d2415e4771d482ea4.en: The is a small word that comes before a noun.
a91d2415e4771d482ea4.id: The adalah kata kecil yang muncul sebelum kata benda (noun).

dfccd632c89ed21c161f.en: Under is a preposition. It tells us where the cat is: under the bed.
dfccd632c89ed21c161f.id: Under adalah kata depan (preposition). Kata ini memberi tahu di mana kucing itu berada: under the bed.

b4e5e6ffc1dac7d9b29c.id: Quickly menunjukkan bagaimana, bukan di mana.

f7e9191836ef1d4e7b97.en: We use in with months: in June. We use on with days and at with clock times.
f7e9191836ef1d4e7b97.id: Kita memakai in untuk bulan: in June. Kita memakai on untuk hari dan at untuk jam.

7c913fce7f939f9209c0.en: On is used for days and dates, like on Monday.
7c913fce7f939f9209c0.id: On dipakai untuk hari dan tanggal, seperti on Monday.

5e06c962d1d337f343d5.en: At is used for clock times, like at three o'clock.
5e06c962d1d337f343d5.id: At dipakai untuk jam, seperti at three o'clock.

67da8b8e2782b231dc7f.en: By does not fit with a month here.
67da8b8e2782b231dc7f.id: By tidak cocok dengan nama bulan di sini.

57878c7ad08fd3dcf52b.en: We use at with clock times: at seven o'clock.
57878c7ad08fd3dcf52b.id: Kita memakai at untuk jam: at seven o'clock.

845e2fa262fa678b22ec.en: In is used for months and years.
845e2fa262fa678b22ec.id: In dipakai untuk bulan dan tahun.

7007076ed9bd51f27875.en: On is used for days and dates.
7007076ed9bd51f27875.id: On dipakai untuk hari dan tanggal.

62e12d2e998786b9cb11.en: Of does not fit with a time.

9ab752b7cbf3026bd48a.en: Quietly, carefully and loudly tell how. Yesterday, soon and tomorrow tell when. Outside, upstairs and nearby tell where.
9ab752b7cbf3026bd48a.id: Quietly, carefully, dan loudly memberi tahu bagaimana (how). Yesterday, soon, dan tomorrow memberi tahu kapan (when). Outside, upstairs, dan nearby memberi tahu di mana (where).

9e76b2e93f7b7e7d6cee.en: After lunch is a fronted adverbial. A comma goes straight after it: After lunch, we played chess.
9e76b2e93f7b7e7d6cee.id: After lunch adalah keterangan di awal kalimat (fronted adverbial). Koma ditulis tepat setelahnya: After lunch, we played chess.

2bb731428d5754791d97.en: After lunch is one phrase. Do not split it.
2bb731428d5754791d97.id: After lunch adalah satu kelompok kata (phrase). Jangan dipisahkan.

5d4ab65f5d5216f4ad40.en: The comma goes at the end of the fronted adverbial.
5d4ab65f5d5216f4ad40.id: Koma diletakkan di akhir keterangan di awal kalimat (fronted adverbial).

825dd87e7bada320e597.en: Chess is part of the main sentence.
825dd87e7bada320e597.id: Chess adalah bagian dari kalimat utama.

42501252d8a663922960.en: Before breakfast tells us when. It comes at the front of the sentence, followed by a comma.
42501252d8a663922960.id: Before breakfast memberi tahu kapan. Keterangan ini ada di awal kalimat, lalu diikuti koma.

a2424ae6dfc5d11a54f1.en: Before breakfast is at the end, not the front.
a2424ae6dfc5d11a54f1.id: Before breakfast ada di akhir, bukan di awal.

73e006f6dccb7db413cb.en: This sentence has no adverbial at the front.
73e006f6dccb7db413cb.id: Kalimat ini tidak punya keterangan (adverbial) di awal.

956540737e95f9f10f13.en: This is not a full sentence.

60247184ec2ab38c965a.en: Under the car is a prepositional phrase. It tells us where the ball rolled.
60247184ec2ab38c965a.id: Under the car adalah frasa preposisi (prepositional phrase). Frasa ini memberi tahu ke mana bola itu menggelinding.

a9bce81f9c4437e7e23c.en: In the morning, Slowly and Without a sound are fronted adverbials, and each one is followed by a comma.
a9bce81f9c4437e7e23c.id: In the morning, Slowly, dan Without a sound adalah keterangan di awal kalimat (fronted adverbial), dan masing-masing diikuti koma.

de708129a3316916be95.en: The comma should go straight after storm.
de708129a3316916be95.id: Koma seharusnya diletakkan tepat setelah storm.

88f531a229807b30b4b5.en: The comma should go straight after Saturday.
88f531a229807b30b4b5.id: Koma seharusnya diletakkan tepat setelah Saturday.

ff536b38abb94ba3d1f2.en: Through means in one side and out of the other. We walked through the forest.
ff536b38abb94ba3d1f2.id: Through berarti masuk dari satu sisi dan keluar dari sisi lainnya. We walked through the forest.

e344782da13a6aa1fbff.en: Between needs things on each side, as in between the trees.
e344782da13a6aa1fbff.id: Between memerlukan benda di kedua sisi, seperti pada between the trees.

ef8831d84b041bcd6ed2.en: You cannot walk under a forest.
ef8831d84b041bcd6ed2.id: Kamu tidak bisa berjalan di bawah hutan.

a8b38733147d17741f72.en: On the forest does not make sense.
a8b38733147d17741f72.id: On the forest tidak masuk akal.

cec0b1b4144ed49595ed.en: As the sun rose is the fronted adverbial, so it goes first with a comma. Then comes the main clause: the farmers opened the gates to the rice fields.
cec0b1b4144ed49595ed.id: As the sun rose adalah keterangan di awal kalimat (fronted adverbial), jadi ditulis paling depan dengan koma. Lalu menyusul induk kalimat (main clause): the farmers opened the gates to the rice fields.

6f5b2ee3e083c454e2d2.en: At the end of a long, busy day is the fronted adverbial. The comma after long is part of the phrase, and another comma goes after day.
6f5b2ee3e083c454e2d2.id: At the end of a long, busy day adalah keterangan di awal kalimat (fronted adverbial). Koma setelah long adalah bagian dari frasa itu, dan satu koma lagi ditulis setelah day.

413810da1d102e48a8c0.en: The comma goes after day, not after we.
413810da1d102e48a8c0.id: Koma diletakkan setelah day, bukan setelah we.

9c56b30d2ef65623ece7.en: Do not put a comma inside the adverbial after end.
9c56b30d2ef65623ece7.id: Jangan menaruh koma di dalam keterangan (adverbial) itu setelah end.

2713e8ff72ee8c95e632.en: Rice and soup belongs with ate. The comma should come after day.
2713e8ff72ee8c95e632.id: Rice and soup harus menyatu dengan ate. Koma seharusnya ada setelah day.

2ed4e2e141851d5ee692.en: Slowly is an adverb. It tells us how the turtle moved.
2ed4e2e141851d5ee692.id: Slowly adalah kata keterangan (adverb). Kata ini memberi tahu bagaimana penyu itu bergerak.

2a3dc3ec5ae17de4b720.en: Yesterday tells us when Rina visited her aunt.
2a3dc3ec5ae17de4b720.id: Yesterday memberi tahu kapan Rina mengunjungi bibinya.

d6a589ffd37d1a490594.en: Rina is the person. It does not tell us when.
d6a589ffd37d1a490594.id: Rina adalah orangnya. Kata ini tidak memberi tahu kita kapan.

2b6e04fa38adcdcade4d.en: Visited is the action. It does not tell us when.
2b6e04fa38adcdcade4d.id: Visited adalah perbuatannya. Kata ini tidak memberi tahu kita kapan.

b172d71a7bf8d0816f0f.en: Aunt is the person visited. It does not tell us when.
b172d71a7bf8d0816f0f.id: Aunt adalah orang yang dikunjungi. Kata ini tidak memberi tahu kita kapan.

b6f81e19b19860aae526.en: Later that day, tells us when. A comma follows it.
b6f81e19b19860aae526.id: Later that day, memberi tahu kapan. Koma ditulis setelahnya.

0981e070ac5e813868eb.en: Before breakfast tells us when Hadi fed the chickens. It comes first, so it is fronted.
0981e070ac5e813868eb.id: Before breakfast memberi tahu kapan Hadi memberi makan ayam. Keterangan ini ada paling depan, jadi disebut fronted.

570fc1c8ee51dbd03693.en: Into tells us where the frog jumped.
570fc1c8ee51dbd03693.id: Into memberi tahu ke mana katak itu melompat.

3144f3cae8ac75e9aff6.en: In the morning is the fronted adverbial of time. The comma comes after it.
3144f3cae8ac75e9aff6.id: In the morning adalah keterangan waktu di awal kalimat (fronted adverbial of time). Koma ditulis setelahnya.

04922be4170d4459f3f8.en: In is only the first word of the adverbial. The comma goes after the whole phrase.
04922be4170d4459f3f8.id: In hanya kata pertama dari keterangan (adverbial) itu. Koma diletakkan setelah seluruh kelompok kata.

bea67f306794cbfd6a39.en: This splits the phrase in the middle.
bea67f306794cbfd6a39.id: Ini memisahkan kelompok kata itu di tengahnya.

fbb3daa02b6a9b02f9bb.en: Mist is the subject of the sentence, so it cannot be cut off from its verb.
fbb3daa02b6a9b02f9bb.id: Mist adalah subjek kalimat, jadi tidak boleh dipisahkan dari kata kerjanya.

bf0d2100ae064c04a886.en: Each adverbial answers one question: place, how often, manner or time.
bf0d2100ae064c04a886.id: Setiap keterangan (adverbial) menjawab satu pertanyaan: tempat, seberapa sering, cara, atau waktu.

bd1f7afab68e6951d0a6.en: Without a sound is the fronted adverbial. The comma goes straight after it.
bd1f7afab68e6951d0a6.id: Without a sound adalah keterangan di awal kalimat (fronted adverbial). Koma ditulis tepat setelahnya.

6e07c988a66fb423f6b0.en: The comma splits the subject from its verb.
6e07c988a66fb423f6b0.id: Koma itu memisahkan subjek dari kata kerjanya.

c6b5ff731aadbb06de98.en: The comma is in the wrong place.
c6b5ff731aadbb06de98.id: Komanya ada di tempat yang salah.

065030e5c9f2281e2610.en: A comma at the end does not follow the fronted adverbial.
065030e5c9f2281e2610.id: Koma di akhir tidak berada setelah keterangan di awal kalimat (fronted adverbial).

0f1bc705c59f4ddaadc3.en: Hadi hid behind the curtain and jumped onto the table.
0f1bc705c59f4ddaadc3.id: Hadi bersembunyi di balik tirai (behind the curtain) dan melompat ke atas meja (onto the table).

2ce44ffd880165153bcc.en: A fronted adverbial opens the sentence and is usually followed by a comma.
2ce44ffd880165153bcc.id: Fronted adverbial membuka kalimat dan biasanya diikuti koma.

3b5a3ca31f4eb2cca3e9.en: With trembling fingers tells us the way Sekar opened the box.
3b5a3ca31f4eb2cca3e9.id: With trembling fingers memberi tahu cara Sekar membuka kotak itu.

ca0c55f437d3164712ad.en: This tells us when, not how.
ca0c55f437d3164712ad.id: Ini memberi tahu kita kapan, bukan bagaimana.

42755866d36475dce788.en: This tells us where, not how.
42755866d36475dce788.id: Ini memberi tahu kita di mana, bukan bagaimana.

fdd20d76a50228be5761.en: This tells us how often, not how.
fdd20d76a50228be5761.id: Ini memberi tahu kita seberapa sering, bukan bagaimana.

9d12eca2d26bb9027af3.en: When the adverbial comes at the end, no comma is needed before it. The owls called later that night.
9d12eca2d26bb9027af3.id: Kalau keterangan (adverbial) ada di akhir kalimat, tidak perlu koma sebelumnya. The owls called later that night.

65aa3533ebda3931d3c1.en: This is right. The comma follows the fronted adverbial.
65aa3533ebda3931d3c1.id: Ini benar. Koma ada setelah keterangan di awal kalimat (fronted adverbial).

ab55bc3a6f9bca27a654.en: Carefully, At the end of the lane and Early in the morning all open their sentences and are followed by a comma.
ab55bc3a6f9bca27a654.id: Carefully, At the end of the lane, dan Early in the morning semuanya membuka kalimat dan diikuti koma.

b684cca75a5a544c017d.en: Carefully is inside the sentence, not at the start.
b684cca75a5a544c017d.id: Carefully ada di dalam kalimat, bukan di awal.

23525e3d0aa274d99007.en: This sentence starts with its subject, not an adverbial.
23525e3d0aa274d99007.id: Kalimat ini dimulai dengan subjeknya, bukan dengan keterangan (adverbial).

9bad5eda247623a5e937.en: Along the muddy path, the buffalo pulled a heavy cart. The adverbial tells where.
9bad5eda247623a5e937.id: Along the muddy path, the buffalo pulled a heavy cart. Keterangan (adverbial) ini memberi tahu di mana.

2273c5ec51dfb8074ed7.en: Beneath the stairs, Gently, and Inside, are all fronted adverbials. There are three.
2273c5ec51dfb8074ed7.id: Beneath the stairs, Gently, dan Inside, semuanya adalah keterangan di awal kalimat (fronted adverbial). Jumlahnya ada tiga.

030652c16352243e95db.en: There are more than one. Look at the start of each sentence.
030652c16352243e95db.id: Jumlahnya lebih dari satu. Lihat awal setiap kalimat.

3d00bc846c175648ba8b.en: There are only three sentences, and each has one.
3d00bc846c175648ba8b.id: Hanya ada tiga kalimat, dan masing-masing punya satu.

ec731b441e5134bdc453.en: After the rain, is the fronted adverbial. Happily and in the garden are further adverbials.
ec731b441e5134bdc453.id: After the rain, adalah keterangan di awal kalimat (fronted adverbial). Happily dan in the garden adalah keterangan tambahan.

431d64c2cd391426a6c2.en: The comma is in the wrong place and is missing after rain.
431d64c2cd391426a6c2.id: Komanya ada di tempat yang salah dan tidak ada setelah rain.

d8298ea8332aff6eca4e.en: There is an extra comma between the subject and the verb.
d8298ea8332aff6eca4e.id: Ada koma tambahan di antara subjek dan kata kerja.

9b56e8496e8d858b91fa.en: Slowly and carefully tell us how the man walked. They are adverbs.
9b56e8496e8d858b91fa.id: Slowly dan carefully memberi tahu bagaimana kakek itu berjalan. Keduanya adalah kata keterangan (adverb).

c3ed6d481909b146fc1d.en: Old is an adjective. It describes the man.
c3ed6d481909b146fc1d.id: Old adalah kata sifat (adjective). Kata ini menggambarkan laki-laki itu.

8167247cc8fae042aafa.en: Always tells how often we visit Grandma, so it is an adverb of frequency.
8167247cc8fae042aafa.id: Always memberi tahu seberapa sering kita mengunjungi Nenek, jadi kata ini adalah kata keterangan frekuensi (adverb of frequency).

35a0291da5498334f285.en: Silently tells us how the cat crept. It helps the reader imagine the cat moving without a sound.
35a0291da5498334f285.id: Silently memberi tahu bagaimana kucing itu mengendap-endap. Kata ini membantu pembaca membayangkan kucing itu bergerak tanpa suara.

d81d1ef08a9a5e5876b5.en: Towards the bird tells where. Silently tells how.
d81d1ef08a9a5e5876b5.id: Towards the bird menunjukkan ke mana. Silently menunjukkan bagaimana.

57d9e578e3c2ad0f56a3.en: The word is not about time.

7bf7e2ed6a436e54dd5c.en: The word does not show a number.

93e86a1a0a91e37a5712.en: An adverb can tell us how an action is done. Quickly tells us how he ran.
93e86a1a0a91e37a5712.id: Kata keterangan (adverb) bisa memberi tahu bagaimana suatu perbuatan dilakukan. Quickly memberi tahu bagaimana dia berlari.

3ea400a1186755baae4b.en: Under shows where the book is in relation to the bed, so it is a preposition.
3ea400a1186755baae4b.id: Under menunjukkan letak buku itu terhadap tempat tidur, jadi kata ini adalah kata depan (preposition).

c555c789e9bf95ba74be.en: A fronted adverbial comes at the start of a sentence and is usually followed by a comma.
c555c789e9bf95ba74be.id: Fronted adverbial ada di awal kalimat dan biasanya diikuti koma.

f28831c69a82d2e78e8b.en: A fronted adverbial comes at the front of the sentence, before the main clause.
f28831c69a82d2e78e8b.id: Fronted adverbial ada di depan kalimat, sebelum induk kalimat (main clause).

269e56775ade97f03b7a.en: A preposition can show where something is in relation to a noun. Beside shows the position of the cat next to the door.
269e56775ade97f03b7a.id: Kata depan (preposition) bisa menunjukkan letak sesuatu terhadap kata benda (noun). Beside menunjukkan posisi kucing itu di samping pintu.
